intro.headline: The place every student in New York should know
intro.body: We teamed up with Korean student associations at each school to bring visa, job, food, and event info together in one place. Plus expert connections.

status.headline: Am I doing this right?
status.body: Get ready with real step-by-step reviews from people who've already been through OPT, CPT, visas, and green cards.

food.headline: No more wondering what to eat today
food.body: Our food list is sorted by menu, not neighborhood, so the moment you crave something, you can search and go.

housing.headline: You don't have to find a place alone anymore
housing.body: Compare verified listings and roommates whose lifestyle fits yours, all in one place.

anonymous.headline: The questions you'd rather not put your name on
anonymous.body: Visas or relationships, it's easier to be honest when you're anonymous.

credit.headline: Invite friends and share reviews
credit.body: Write a detailed OPT, CPT, or visa review, and both you and the friend who invited you earn points.

expert.headline: Use your Misaeng Points to meet experts
expert.body: Use your points for a coffee chat with someone working in your target field, or book a consultation with an expert.

banner.alt: Ellieo — the community for international students in the US. Every member is verified with a school or work email, a place you can truly trust. See our mission.

explore.title: Explore Ellieo
explore.subtitle: Boards for housing, visas, jobs and everyday life in {city}.

meta.title: About Ellieo
meta.description: Ellieo exists to be the most trustworthy place for international students and professionals building a life in the US.

hero.title: Far from home, you deserve people you can trust.
hero.subline: Ellieo exists for one reason: to be the most trustworthy place for international students and professionals building a life in the US.

mission.text: No one starting a life far from home should have to guess who to trust.

moments.title: The moments we built Ellieo for
moments.intro: Moving abroad takes courage. These are the moments when one honest answer changes everything.

deposit.title: “Just send the deposit first.”
deposit.body: A stranger, a perfect apartment, and a request that feels wrong. On Ellieo, you always know who you're talking to.

visa.title: 2 a.m., refreshing an OPT forum
visa.body: Timelines buried in group chats and rumors. Here, people who just went through it share every step.

interview.title: The interview nobody prepared you for
interview.body: Sponsorship questions, case rounds, salary talk — honest reviews from people who sat in that chair.

winter.title: The first winter alone
winter.body: No family nearby, no one who gets it — yet. Find your people, your food and your corner of the city.

promise.title: Our promise to you
promise.intro: Trust isn't a feature we added. It's the reason Ellieo exists.

verified.title: Verified members only
verified.body: Everyone joins with a school or work email, so you know you're talking to a real student or professional.

real.title: Real experiences, not ads
real.body: Reviews and stories come from the members who lived them.

safety.title: Safety comes first
safety.body: See something that feels off? Report it — our team reviews every report and follows up.

card.label: Illustration
card.title: Verified member
card.caption: Every profile on Ellieo is tied to a real school or work email.

housing.title: Housing
housing.body: Rentals, roommates and sublets from people you can trust.

visa.title: Visa
visa.body: OPT, CPT and green card timelines, shared step by step by people who went through them.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.body: Company pages, internship and new grad postings, and honest interview reviews.

community.title: Community
community.body: Food, events and anonymous Q&A for everyday life in {city}.

care.title: We build for the person who's doing it alone.
care.body1: The person reading a lease in a second language. Waiting on a visa decision with their whole future on it. Spending a holiday far from everyone they love.
care.body2: Every feature has to pass one test: would we trust this ourselves? If the answer isn't an easy yes, it doesn't ship.
care.closing: Helping you feel safe, informed and a little less alone — that's the work we wake up for.

cta.title: You don't have to figure it out alone.
cta.body: Join a community where every member is verified and everyone is here to help.
